data.notes: It got the real reason: Adyen used customer-specific test results, we answered with averages, our analysis arrived late, and nobody had a relationship with the new head of payments. It also challenges the rep's 'nothing to do' framing, keeps the Adyen results unknown and captures the customer's language well. The decider finding concludes 'Stefan was the decider, not a champion we had built' rather than saying the decision was effectively made before we engaged, and the review never cites the missing business review (9–10 months).
